newsitem.title: USA: Trikon Tech says CFO La Valle resigns.
newsitem.headline: Trikon Tech says CFO La Valle resigns.

text.p: Trikon Technologies Inc, an equipment supplier to semiconductor manufacturers, Thursday said Chief Financial Officer John La Valle has resigned to take a job with ComCore Semiconductor Inc, a venture-backed company.
In a statement, Trikon said it named Steve Cordial, formerly chief financial officer for Xylan Corp, as its acting CFO until a permanent replacement for La Valle can be hired.
Cordial has more than 10 years experience as a corporate financial officer, including several years as vice president and chief financial officer of Sierra Semiconductor.
